title: The Great Flood
summary: And Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth.
summary_zh: 当洪水泛滥在地上的时候，挪亚整六百岁。

title: The flood subsides
summary: And God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that was with him in the ark: and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters asswaged;
summary_zh: 神记念挪亚和挪亚方舟里的一切走兽牲畜。神叫风吹地，水势渐落。

title: Leaving the Ark
summary: And God spake unto Noah, saying,
summary_zh: 神对挪亚说：

title: Tower of Babel
summary: And the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.
summary_zh: 那时，天下人的口音、言语都是一样。

title: Birth of Abraham
summary: And Terah lived seventy years, and begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
summary_zh: 他拉活到七十岁，生了亚伯兰、拿鹤、哈兰。

title: Judgeship of Jair
summary: And after him arose Jair, a Gileadite, and judged Israel twenty and two years.
summary_zh: 在他以后有基列人睚珥兴起，作以色列的士师二十二年。

title: Death of Terah
summary: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years: and Terah died in Haran.
summary_zh: 他拉共活了二百零五岁，就死在哈兰。

title: Abraham enters Canaan
summary: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram’s wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and…
summary_zh: 他拉带著他儿子亚伯兰和他孙子哈兰的儿子罗得，并他儿妇亚伯兰的妻子撒莱，出了迦勒底的吾珥，要往迦南地去；他们走到哈兰，就住在那里。

title: Abraham goes to Egypt
summary: And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine was grievous in the land.
summary_zh: 那地遭遇饥荒。因饥荒甚大，亚伯兰就下埃及去，要在那里暂居。

title: Sojourn in Canaan and Egypt
summary: Now the sojourning of the children of Israel, who dwelt in Egypt, was four hundred and thirty years.
summary_zh: 以色列人住在埃及共有四百三十年。

title: Abraham and Lot Separate
summary: And Abram went up out of Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the south.
summary_zh: 亚伯兰带著他的妻子与罗得，并一切所有的，都从埃及上南地去。

title: Sodom Destroyed
summary: And the Lord said, Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous;
summary_zh: 耶和华说：「所多玛和蛾摩拉的罪恶甚重，声闻于我。

title: Nimrod's kingdom begins
summary: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.
summary_zh: 古实又生宁录，他为世上英雄之首。

title: Death of Abraham
summary: And these are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived, an hundred threescore and fifteen years.
summary_zh: 亚伯拉罕一生的年日是一百七十五岁。

title: Birth of Joseph
summary: And she conceived, and bare a son; and said, God hath taken away my reproach:
summary_zh: 拉结怀孕生子，说：「神除去了我的羞耻」，

title: Lifetime of Joseph
summary: And she conceived, and bare a son; and said, God hath taken away my reproach:
summary_zh: 拉结怀孕生子，说：「神除去了我的羞耻」，

title: Rachel dies giving birth to Benjamin
summary: And they journeyed from Beth–el; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour.
summary_zh: 他们从伯特利起行，离以法他还有一段路程，拉结临产甚是艰难。

title: Joseph sold to Egypt
summary: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colours.
summary_zh: 以色列原来爱约瑟过于爱他的众子，因为约瑟是他年老生的；他给约瑟做了一件彩衣。

title: Joseph imprisoned
summary: And Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, a place where the king’s prisoners were bound: and he was there in the prison.
summary_zh: 把约瑟下在监里，就是王的囚犯被囚的地方。于是约瑟在那里坐监。

title: Death of Isaac
summary: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years.
summary_zh: 以撒共活了一百八十岁。

title: Joseph Promoted in Egypt
title_zh: 约瑟在埃及被立为宰相
summary: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.
summary_zh: 法老和他一切臣仆都以这事为妙。

title: 7 years of plenty
summary: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.
summary_zh: 七个丰年之内，地的出产极丰极盛（原文是一把一把的），

title: Joseph's brothers return to Egypt
title_zh: 约瑟的哥哥们再下埃及
summary: And the famine was sore in the land.
summary_zh: 那地的饥荒甚大。

title: Death of Jacob
summary: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years: so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years.
summary_zh: 雅各住在埃及地十七年，雅各平生的年日是一百四十七岁。

title: Death of Joseph
summary: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he, and his father’s house: and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years.
summary_zh: 约瑟和他父亲的眷属都住在埃及。约瑟活了一百一十岁。

title: Birth of Moses
summary: And there went a man of the house of Levi, and took to wife a daughter of Levi.
summary_zh: 有一个利未家的人娶了一个利未女子为妻。

title: Lifetime of Moses
summary: And the woman conceived, and bare a son: and when she saw him that he was a goodly child, she hid him three months.
summary_zh: 那女人怀孕，生一个儿子，见他俊美，就藏了他三个月，

title: Exodus from Egypt
summary: And I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a God: and ye shall know that I am the Lord your God, which bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.
summary_zh: 我要以你们为我的百姓，我也要作你们的神。你们要知道我是耶和华─你们的神，是救你们脱离埃及人之重担的。

title: Wilderness Wanderings
summary: But God led the people about, through the way of the wilderness of the Red sea: and the children of Israel went up harnessed out of the land of Egypt.
summary_zh: 所以神领百姓绕道而行，走红海旷野的路。以色列人出埃及地，都带著兵器上去。

title: Ten Commandments Given
summary: In the third month, when the children of Israel were gone forth out of the land of Egypt, the same day came they into the wilderness of Sinai.
summary_zh: 以色列人出埃及地以后，满了三个月的那一天，就来到西奈的旷野。

title: Death of Moses
summary: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.
summary_zh: 利亚给雅各所生的女儿底拿出去，要见那地的女子们。

title: Crossing the Jordan into Canaan
summary: Now after the death of Moses the servant of the Lord it came to pass, that the Lord spake unto Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ minister, saying,
summary_zh: 耶和华的仆人摩西死了以后，耶和华晓谕摩西的帮手，嫩的儿子约书亚，说：

title: Death of Joshua
summary: And it came to pass after these things, that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the Lord, died, being an hundred and ten years old.
summary_zh: 这些事以后，耶和华的仆人嫩的儿子约书亚，正一百一十岁，就死了。

title: Subjugation by Cushan-rishathaim
summary: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord, and forgat the Lord their God, and served Baalim and the groves.
summary_zh: 以色列人行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，忘记耶和华─他们的神，去事奉诸巴力和亚舍拉，

title: Deliverance by Othniel
summary: Nevertheless the Lord raised up judges, which delivered them out of the hand of those that spoiled them.
summary_zh: 耶和华兴起士师，士师就拯救他们脱离抢夺他们人的手。

title: Subjugation by Eglon
summary: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the Lord: and the Lord strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done evil in the sight of the Lord.
summary_zh: 以色列人又行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，耶和华就使摩押王伊矶伦强盛，攻击以色列人。

title: Deliverance by Ehud
summary: But when the children of Israel cried unto the Lord, the Lord raised them up a deliverer, Ehud the son of Gera, a Benjamite, a man lefthanded: and by him the children of Israel sent a present unto Eglon the king of Moab.
summary_zh: 以色列人呼求耶和华的时候，耶和华就为他们兴起一位拯救者，就是便雅悯人基拉的儿子以笏；他是左手便利的。以色列人托他送礼物给摩押王伊矶伦。

title: Subjugation by Jabin
summary: And the children of Israel again did evil in the sight of the Lord, when Ehud was dead.
summary_zh: 以笏死后，以色列人又行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，

title: Deliverance by Barak And Deborah
title_zh: 巴拉和底波拉拯救以色列
summary: And Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth, she judged Israel at that time.
summary_zh: 有一位女先知名叫底波拉，是拉比多的妻，当时作以色列的士师。

title: Subjugation by Midian
summary: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord: and the Lord delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.
summary_zh: 以色列人又行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，耶和华就把他们交在米甸人手里七年。

title: Deliverance by Gideon
summary: And there came an angel of the Lord, and sat under an oak which was in Ophrah, that pertained unto Joash the Abi–ezrite: and his son Gideon threshed wheat by the winepress, to hide it from the Midianites.
summary_zh: 耶和华的使者到了俄弗拉，坐在亚比以谢族人约阿施的橡树下。约阿施的儿子基甸正在酒醡那里打麦子，为要防备米甸人。

title: Usurpation by Abimelech
summary: And Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and dwelt in his own house.
summary_zh: 约阿施的儿子耶路‧巴力回去，住在自己家里。

title: Judgeship of Tola
summary: And after Abimelech there arose to defend Israel Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar; and he dwelt in Shamir in mount Ephraim.
summary_zh: 亚比米勒以后，有以萨迦人朵多的孙子、普瓦的儿子陀拉兴起，拯救以色列人。他住在以法莲山地的沙密。

title: Oppression by Ammon and Philistia
title_zh: 亚扪人和非利士人的欺压
summary: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the Lord, and served Baalim, and Ashtaroth, and the gods of Syria, and the gods of Zidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistine…
summary_zh: 以色列人又行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，去事奉诸巴力和亚斯她录，并亚兰的神、西顿的神、摩押的神、亚扪人的神、非利士人的神，离弃耶和华，不事奉他。

title: Judgeship of Eli
summary: Now Eli was ninety and eight years old; and his eyes were dim, that he could not see.
summary_zh: 那时以利九十八岁了，眼目发直，不能看见。

title: Deliverance by Jephthah
summary: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valour, and he was the son of an harlot: and Gilead begat Jephthah.
summary_zh: 基列人耶弗他是个大能的勇士，是妓女的儿子。耶弗他是基列所生的。

title: Judgeship of Ibzan
summary: And after him Ibzan of Beth–lehem judged Israel.
summary_zh: 耶弗他以后，有伯利恒人以比赞作以色列的士师。

title: Philistine Dominion
summary: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the Lord; and the Lord delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years.
summary_zh: 以色列人又行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，耶和华将他们交在非利士人手中四十年。

title: Judgeship of Elon
summary: And after him Elon, a Zebulonite, judged Israel; and he judged Israel ten years.
summary_zh: 以比赞之后，有西布伦人以伦，作以色列的士师十年。

title: Judgeship of Abdon
summary: And after him Abdon the son of Hillel, a Pirathonite, judged Israel.
summary_zh: 以伦之后，有比拉顿人希列的儿子押顿作以色列的士师。

title: Judgeship of Samson
summary: And he judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years.
summary_zh: 当非利士人辖制以色列人的时候，参孙作以色列的士师二十年。

title: Death of Saul
summary: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him; and he was sore wounded of the archers.
summary_zh: 势派甚大，扫罗被弓箭手追上，射伤甚重，

title: Reign of David
summary: And it came to pass after this, that David enquired of the Lord, saying, Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah? And the Lord said unto him, Go up. And David said, Whither shall I go up? And he said, Unto Hebron.
summary_zh: 此后，大卫问耶和华说：「我上犹大的一个城去可以吗？」耶和华说：「可以。」大卫说：「我上哪一个城去呢？」耶和华说：「上希伯仑去。」

title: Death of David
summary: So David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.
summary_zh: 大卫与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城。

title: Reign of Solomon
summary: Then sat Solomon upon the throne of David his father; and his kingdom was established greatly.
summary_zh: 所罗门坐他父亲大卫的位，他的国甚是坚固。

title: Construction of Solomon's Temple
summary: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father: for Hiram was ever a lover of David.
summary_zh: 泰尔王希兰，平素爱大卫；他听见以色列人膏所罗门，接续他父亲作王，就差遣臣仆来见他。

title: Death of Solomon
summary: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.
summary_zh: 所罗门与他列祖同睡，葬在他父亲大卫的城里。他儿子罗波安接续他作王。

title: Reign of Rehoboam
summary: But as for the children of Israel which dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
summary_zh: 惟独住犹大城邑的以色列人，罗波安仍作他们的王。

title: Reign of Jeroboam I
summary: And it came to pass, when all Israel heard that Jeroboam was come again, that they sent and called him unto the congregation, and made him king over all Israel: there was none that followed the house of David, but the tribe of Judah only.
summary_zh: 以色列众人听见耶罗波安回来了，就打发人去请他到会众面前，立他作以色列众人的王。除了犹大支派以外，没有顺从大卫家的。

title: Reign of Abijam
summary: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam the son of Nebat reigned Abijam over Judah.
summary_zh: 尼八的儿子耶罗波安王十八年，亚比央登基作犹大王，

title: Death of Abijam
summary: And Abijam slept with his fathers; and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead.
summary_zh: 亚比央与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫的城里。他儿子亚撒接续他作王。

title: Reign of Asa
summary: And in the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel reigned Asa over Judah.
summary_zh: 以色列王耶罗波安二十年，亚撒登基作犹大王，

title: Reign of Nadab
summary: And Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned over Israel two years.
summary_zh: 犹大王亚撒第二年，耶罗波安的儿子拿答登基作以色列王共二年，

title: Reign of Baasha
summary: In the third year of Asa king of Judah began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Israel in Tirzah, twenty and four years.
summary_zh: 犹大王亚撒第三年，亚希雅的儿子巴沙在得撒登基作以色列众人的王共二十四年。

title: Reign of Elah
summary: So Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah: and Elah his son reigned in his stead.
summary_zh: 巴沙与他列祖同睡，葬在得撒。他儿子以拉接续他作王。

title: Reign of Zimri
summary: In the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah did Zimri reign seven days in Tirzah. And the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.
summary_zh: 犹大王亚撒二十七年，心利在得撒作王七日。那时民正安营围攻非利士的基比顿。

title: Reign of Tibni
summary: Then were the people of Israel divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king; and half followed Omri.
summary_zh: 那时，以色列民分为两半：一半随从基纳的儿子提比尼，要立他作王；一半随从暗利。

title: Reign of Omri
summary: But the people that followed Omri prevailed against the people that followed Tibni the son of Ginath: so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.
summary_zh: 但随从暗利的民胜过随从基纳的儿子提比尼的民。提比尼死了，暗利就作了王。

title: Reign of Ahab
summary: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria: and Ahab his son reigned in his stead.
summary_zh: 暗利与他列祖同睡，葬在撒马利亚。他儿子亚哈接续他作王。

title: Death of Omri
summary: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria: and Ahab his son reigned in his stead.
summary_zh: 暗利与他列祖同睡，葬在撒马利亚。他儿子亚哈接续他作王。

title: Death of Asa
summary: And Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead.
summary_zh: 亚撒与他列祖同睡，葬在他祖大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子约沙法接续他作王。

title: Reign of Jehoshaphat
summary: And Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.
summary_zh: 以色列王亚哈第四年，亚撒的儿子约沙法登基作了犹大王。

title: Death of Jehoshaphat
summary: And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.
summary_zh: 约沙法与列祖同睡。葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子约兰接续他作王。

title: Reign of Ahaziah
summary: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned two years over Israel.
summary_zh: 犹大王约沙法十七年，亚哈的儿子亚哈谢在撒马利亚登基，作以色列王共二年。

title: Reign of Joram
summary: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned twelve years.
summary_zh: 犹大王约沙法十八年，亚哈的儿子约兰在撒马利亚登基作了以色列王十二年。

title: Reign of Jehoram
summary: So he died according to the word of the Lord which Elijah had spoken. And Jehoram reigned in his stead in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah; because he had no son.
summary_zh: 亚哈谢果然死了，正如耶和华借以利亚所说的话。因他没有儿子，他兄弟约兰接续他作王，正在犹大王约沙法的儿子约兰第二年。

title: Reign of Ahaziah (Jehoahaz)
summary: In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel did Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah begin to reign.
summary_zh: 以色列王亚哈的儿子约兰十二年，犹大王约兰的儿子亚哈谢登基。

title: Reign of Jehu
summary: And when thou comest thither, look out there Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, and go in, and make him arise up from among his brethren, and carry him to an inner chamber;
summary_zh: 到了那里，要寻找宁示的孙子、约沙法的儿子耶户，使他从同僚中起来，带他进严密的屋子，

title: Reign of Athaliah
summary: And when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal.
summary_zh: 亚哈谢的母亲亚她利雅见她儿子死了，就起来剿灭王室。

title: Death of Jehoram
summary: And Joram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.
summary_zh: 约兰与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子亚哈谢接续他作王。

title: Reign of Joash
summary: Seven years old was Jehoash when he began to reign.
summary_zh: 约阿施登基的时候年方七岁。

title: Death of Jehu
summary: And Jehu slept with his fathers: and they buried him in Samaria. And Jehoahaz his son reigned in his stead.
summary_zh: 耶户与他列祖同睡，葬在撒马利亚；他儿子约哈斯接续他作王。

title: Reign of Jehoahaz
summary: In the three and twentieth year of Joash the son of Ahaziah king of Judah Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned seventeen years.
summary_zh: 犹大王亚哈谢的儿子约阿施二十三年，耶户的儿子约哈斯在撒马利亚登基作以色列王十七年。

title: Death of Jehoahaz
summary: And Jehoahaz slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria: and Joash his son reigned in his stead.
summary_zh: 约哈斯与他列祖同睡，葬在撒马利亚。他儿子约阿施接续他作王。

title: Reign of Jehoash
summary: In the thirty and seventh year of Joash king of Judah began Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned sixteen years.
summary_zh: 犹大王约阿施三十七年，约哈斯的儿子约阿施在撒马利亚登基作以色列王十六年。

title: Reign of Amaziah
summary: In the second year of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel reigned Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah.
summary_zh: 以色列王约哈斯的儿子约阿施第二年，犹大王约阿施的儿子亚玛谢登基。

title: Reign of Jeroboam II
summary: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel began to reign in Samaria, and reigned forty and one years.
summary_zh: 犹大王约阿施的儿子亚玛谢十五年，以色列王约阿施的儿子耶罗波安在撒马利亚登基，作王四十一年。

title: Death of Jehoahash
summary: And Joash slept with his fathers; and Jeroboam sat upon his throne: and Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.
summary_zh: 约阿施与他列祖同睡，耶罗波安坐了他的位。约阿施与以色列诸王一同葬在撒马利亚。

title: Reign of Uzziah
summary: In the twenty and seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel began Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah to reign.
summary_zh: 以色列王耶罗波安二十七年，犹大王亚玛谢的儿子亚撒利雅登基，

title: Reign of Zachariah
summary: In the thirty and eighth year of Azariah king of Judah did Zachariah the son of Jeroboam reign over Israel in Samaria six months.
summary_zh: 犹大王亚撒利雅三十八年，耶罗波安的儿子撒迦利雅在撒马利亚作以色列王六个月。

title: Reign of Shallum
summary: And Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and smote him before the people, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.
summary_zh: 雅比的儿子沙龙背叛他，在百姓面前击杀他，篡了他的位。

title: Death of Shallum
summary: For Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, and came to Samaria, and smote Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.
summary_zh: 迦底的儿子米拿现从得撒上撒马利亚，杀了雅比的儿子沙龙，篡了他的位。

title: Reign of Menahem
summary: In the nine and thirtieth year of Azariah king of Judah began Menahem the son of Gadi to reign over Israel, and reigned ten years in Samaria.
summary_zh: 犹大王亚撒利雅三十九年，迦底的儿子米拿现登基，在撒马利亚作以色列王十年。

title: Reign of Pekahiah
summary: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned two years.
summary_zh: 犹大王亚撒利雅五十年，米拿现的儿子比加辖在撒马利亚登基作以色列王二年。

title: Death of Pekahiah
summary: But Pekah the son of Remaliah, a captain of his, conspired against him, and smote him in Samaria, in the palace of the king’s house, with Argob and Arieh, and with him fifty men of the Gileadites: and he killed him, and reigned in his room.
summary_zh: 比加辖的将军、利玛利的儿子比加背叛他，在撒马利亚王宫里的卫所杀了他。亚珥歌伯和亚利耶并基列的五十人帮助比加；比加击杀他，篡了他的位。

title: Reign of Pekah
summary: In the two and fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned twenty years.
summary_zh: 犹大王亚撒利雅五十二年，利玛利的儿子比加在撒马利亚登基作以色列王二十年。

title: Death of Uzziah
summary: So Azariah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.
summary_zh: 亚撒利雅与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子约坦接续他作王。

title: Reign of Jotham
summary: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel began Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah to reign.
summary_zh: 以色列王利玛利的儿子比加第二年，犹大王乌西雅的儿子约坦登基。

title: Reign of Ahaz
summary: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.
summary_zh: 利玛利的儿子比加十七年，犹大王约坦的儿子亚哈斯登基。

title: Death of Jotham
summary: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.
summary_zh: 约坦与他列祖同睡，葬在他祖大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子亚哈斯接续他作王。

title: Reign of Hoshea
summary: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years.
summary_zh: 犹大王亚哈斯十二年，以拉的儿子何细亚在撒马利亚登基作以色列王九年。

title: Death of Ahaz
summary: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.
summary_zh: 亚哈斯与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子希西家接续他作王。

title: Reign of Hezekiah
summary: Now it came to pass in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, that Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.
summary_zh: 以色列王以拉的儿子何细亚第三年，犹大王亚哈斯的儿子希西家登基。

title: Reign of Manasseh
summary: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Hephzi–bah.
summary_zh: 玛拿西登基的时候年十二岁，在耶路撒冷作王五十五年。他母亲名叫协西巴。

title: Death of Manasseh
summary: And Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.
summary_zh: 玛拿西与他列祖同睡，葬在自己宫院乌撒的园内；他儿子亚们接续他作王。

title: Reign of Amon
summary: Amon was twenty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Meshullemeth, the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.
summary_zh: 亚们登基的时候年二十二岁，在耶路撒冷作王二年。他母亲名叫米舒利密，是约提巴人哈鲁斯的女儿。

title: Death of Amon
summary: And the servants of Amon conspired against him, and slew the king in his own house.
summary_zh: 亚们王的臣仆背叛他，在宫里杀了他。

title: Reign of Josiah
summary: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jedidah, the daughter of Adaiah of Boscath.
summary_zh: 约西亚登基的时候年八岁，在耶路撒冷作王三十一年。他母亲名叫耶底大，是波斯加人亚大雅的女儿。

title: Death of Josiah
summary: In his days Pharaoh–nechoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates: and king Josiah went against him; and he slew him at Megiddo, when he had seen him.
summary_zh: 约西亚年间，埃及王法老尼哥上到幼发拉底河攻击亚述王；约西亚王去抵挡他。埃及王遇见约西亚在米吉多，就杀了他。

title: Reign of Johoahaz (Shallum)
summary: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
summary_zh: 约哈斯登基的时候年二十三岁，在耶路撒冷作王三个月。他母亲名叫哈慕她，是立拿人耶利米的女儿。

title: Reign of Jehoiakim
summary: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Zebudah, the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.
summary_zh: 约雅敬登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王十一年。他母亲名叫西布大，是鲁玛人毘大雅的女儿。

title: Reign of Jeconiah
summary: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. And his mother’s name was Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.
summary_zh: 约雅斤登基的时候年十八岁，在耶路撒冷作王三个月。他母亲名叫尼护施她，是耶路撒冷人以利拿单的女儿。

title: Reign of Zedekiah
summary: Zedekiah was twenty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
summary_zh: 西底家登基的时候年二十一岁，在耶路撒冷作王十一年。他母亲名叫哈慕她，是立拿人耶利米的女儿。

title: Espousal of Mary
summary: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.
summary_zh: 耶稣基督降生的事记在下面：他母亲马利亚已经许配了约瑟，还没有迎娶，马利亚就从圣灵怀了孕。

title: John's birth predicted
summary: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.
summary_zh: 当犹太王希律的时候，亚比雅班里有一个祭司，名叫撒迦利亚；他妻子是亚伦的后人，名叫伊利莎白。

title: An Angel Speaks to Joseph in a Dream
title_zh: 天使在梦中向约瑟显现
summary: Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a publick example, was minded to put her away privily.
summary_zh: 她丈夫约瑟是个义人，不愿意明明地羞辱她，想要暗暗地把她休了。

title: The Annuciation
summary: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,
summary_zh: 到了第六个月，天使加百列奉神的差遣往加利利的一座城去（这城名叫拿撒勒），

title: Wise Men Visit Herod
summary: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,
summary_zh: 当希律王的时候，耶稣生在犹太的伯利恒。有几个博士从东方来到耶路撒冷，说：

title: Wise Men Visit Jesus
summary: When they had heard the king, they departed; and, lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.
summary_zh: 他们听见王的话就去了。在东方所看见的那星忽然在他们前头行，直行到小孩子的地方，就在上头停住了。

title: Joseph and Mary Flee to Egypt
title_zh: 约瑟和马利亚逃往埃及
summary: And when they were departed, behold, the angel of the Lord appeareth to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be thou there until I bring thee word: for Herod will seek the youn…
summary_zh: 他们去后，有主的使者向约瑟梦中显现，说：「起来！带著小孩子同他母亲逃往埃及，住在那里，等我吩咐你；因为希律必寻找小孩子，要除灭他。」

title: Herod slays male children
summary: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked of the wise men, was exceeding wroth, and sent forth, and slew all the children that were in Bethlehem, and in all the coasts thereof, from two years old and under, according to the time which he…
summary_zh: 希律见自己被博士愚弄，就大大发怒，差人将伯利恒城里并四境所有的男孩，照著他向博士仔细查问的时候，凡两岁以里的，都杀尽了。

title: Joseph and Mary return from Egypt
title_zh: 约瑟和马利亚从埃及回来
summary: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeareth in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,
summary_zh: 希律死了以后，有主的使者在埃及向约瑟梦中显现，说：

title: Joseph and Mary return to Nazareth
title_zh: 约瑟和马利亚回到拿撒勒
summary: But when he heard that Archelaus did reign in Judea in the room of his father Herod, he was afraid to go thither: notwithstanding, being warned of God in a dream, he turned aside into the parts of Galilee:
summary_zh: 只因听见亚基老接著他父亲希律作了犹太王，就怕往那里去，又在梦中被主指示，便往加利利境内去了，

title: Birth of Jesus
summary: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Cesar Augustus, that all the world should be taxed.
summary_zh: 当那些日子，凯撒奥古斯都有旨意下来，叫天下人民都报名上册。

title: Temple Presentation of Jesus
summary: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord;
summary_zh: 按摩西律法满了洁净的日子，他们带著孩子上耶路撒冷去，要把他献与主，

title: Childhood of Jesus
summary: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.
summary_zh: 孩子渐渐长大，强健起来，充满智慧，又有神的恩在他身上。

title: Jesus as a child in the Temple
summary: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.
summary_zh: 每年到逾越节，他父母就上耶路撒冷去。

title: Jesus Growing Up
summary: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
summary_zh: 他就同他们下去，回到拿撒勒，并且顺从他们。他母亲把这一切的事都存在心里。

title: John the Baptist Begins Ministry
summary: In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judea,
summary_zh: 那时，有施洗的约翰出来，在犹太的旷野传道，说：

title: John Baptizes Jesus
summary: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.
summary_zh: 当下，耶稣从加利利来到约旦河，见了约翰，要受他的洗。

title: Jesus Leaves Judea toward Galilee
title_zh: 耶稣离开犹太往加利利去
summary: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison, he departed into Galilee;
summary_zh: 耶稣听见约翰下了监，就退到加利利去；

title: Jesus visits Galilee
summary: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison, he departed into Galilee;
summary_zh: 耶稣听见约翰下了监，就退到加利利去；

title: Jesus in Capernaum
summary: And leaving Nazareth, he came and dwelt in Capernaum, which is upon the sea coast, in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim:
summary_zh: 后又离开拿撒勒，往迦百农去，就住在那里。那地方靠海，在西布伦和拿弗他利的边界上。

title: Fishers of Men
summary: And Jesus, walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brethren, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
summary_zh: 耶稣在加利利海边行走，看见弟兄二人，就是那称呼彼得的西门和他兄弟安得烈，在海里撒网；他们本是打鱼的。

title: Peter's Mother-in-law and Others Healed
title_zh: 医治彼得的岳母和许多人
summary: And when Jesus was come into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother laid, and sick of a fever.
summary_zh: 耶稣到了彼得家里，见彼得的岳母害热病躺著。

title: The Demoniac
summary: And they went into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue, and taught.
summary_zh: 到了迦百农，耶稣就在安息日进了会堂教训人。

title: Jesus Rejected at Nazareth
summary: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.
summary_zh: 耶稣来到拿撒勒，就是他长大的地方。在安息日，照他平常的规矩进了会堂，站起来要念圣经。

title: Water to Wine
summary: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:
summary_zh: 第三日，在加利利的迦拿有娶亲的筵席，耶稣的母亲在那里。

title: Visiting Capernaum
summary: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples: and they continued there not many days.
summary_zh: 这事以后，耶稣与他的母亲、弟兄，和门徒都下迦百农去，在那里住了不多几日。

title: First Passover and Temple Cleansing
title_zh: 第一次逾越节与洁净圣殿
summary: And the Jews’ passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,
summary_zh: 犹太人的逾越节近了，耶稣就上耶路撒冷去。

title: Jesus and Nicodemus
summary: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:
summary_zh: 有一个法利赛人，名叫尼哥底母，是犹太人的官。

title: John the Baptist Witnesses
summary: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judea; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.
summary_zh: 这事以后，耶稣和门徒到了犹太地，在那里居住，施洗。

title: The Samaritan Woman
summary: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
summary_zh: 于是到了撒马利亚的一座城，名叫叙加，靠近雅各给他儿子约瑟的那块地。

title: Sermon on the Mount
summary: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain: and when he was set, his disciples came unto him:
summary_zh: 耶稣看见这许多的人，就上了山，既已坐下，门徒到他跟前来，

title: Healing the Leper
summary: When he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
summary_zh: 耶稣下了山，有许多人跟著他。

title: Healing Centurion's Servant
summary: And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him,
summary_zh: 耶稣进了迦百农，有一个百夫长进前来，求他说：

title: Healing the Man with Palsy
summary: And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city.
summary_zh: 耶稣上了船，渡过海，来到自己的城里。

title: Jesus Calls Matthew
summary: And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.
summary_zh: 耶稣从那里往前走，看见一个人名叫马太，坐在税关上，就对他说：「你跟从我来。」他就起来跟从了耶稣。

title: Fasting Question
summary: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but thy disciples fast not?
summary_zh: 那时，约翰的门徒来见耶稣，说：「我们和法利赛人常常禁食，你的门徒倒不禁食，这是为甚么呢？」

title: Parable of the Winseskins
summary: No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment, and the rent is made worse.
summary_zh: 没有人把新布补在旧衣服上；因为所补上的反带坏了那衣服，破的就更大了。

title: Capernaum Miracles
summary: While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.
summary_zh: 耶稣说这话的时候，有一个管会堂的来拜他，说：「我女儿刚才死了，求你去按手在她身上，她就必活了。」

title: Apostles Chosen
summary: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;
summary_zh: 这十二使徒的名：头一个叫西门（又称彼得），还有他兄弟安得烈，西庇太的儿子雅各和雅各的兄弟约翰，

title: Jesus' Message on John the Baptist
summary: Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples,
summary_zh: 约翰在监里听见基督所做的事，就打发两个门徒去，

title: Woe to Chorazin and Bethsaida
title_zh: 哥拉汛和伯赛大有祸了
summary: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done, because they repented not:
summary_zh: 耶稣在诸城中行了许多异能，那些城的人终不悔改，就在那时候责备他们，说：

title: Corn on the Sabbath
summary: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn; and his disciples were an hungred, and began to pluck the ears of corn, and to eat.
summary_zh: 那时，耶稣在安息日从麦地经过。他的门徒饿了，就掐起麦穗来吃。

title: Healing a Withered Hand
title_zh: 医治枯干了一只手的人
summary: And when he was departed thence, he went into their synagogue:
summary_zh: 耶稣离开那地方，进了一个会堂。

title: Healing Multitudes
summary: But when Jesus knew it, he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;
summary_zh: 耶稣知道了，就离开那里，有许多人跟著他。他把其中有病的人都治好了；

title: Blind and Dumb Demoniac and Following Discourse
title_zh: 医治又瞎又哑被鬼附的人及随后的讲论
summary: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.
summary_zh: 当下，有人将一个被鬼附著、又瞎又哑的人带到耶稣那里，耶稣就医治他，甚至那哑巴又能说话，又能看见。

title: Seaside Parables and Miracle
summary: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him, he gave commandment to depart unto the other side.
summary_zh: 耶稣见许多人围著他，就吩咐渡到那边去。

title: Jesus' 1st Tour of Galilee
title_zh: 耶稣第一次巡行加利利
summary: And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people.
summary_zh: 耶稣走遍加利利，在各会堂里教训人，传天国的福音，医治百姓各样的病症。

title: Widow's Son Resurrected
summary: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.
summary_zh: 过了不多时（有古卷：次日），耶稣往一座城去，这城名叫拿因，他的门徒和极多的人与他同行。

title: Anointed by a Sinner Woman
title_zh: 有罪的女人用香膏抹耶稣
summary: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee’s house, and sat down to meat.
summary_zh: 有一个法利赛人请耶稣和他吃饭；耶稣就到法利赛人家里去坐席。

title: Jesus' 2nd Tour of Galilee
title_zh: 耶稣第二次巡行加利利
summary: And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God: and the twelve were with him,
summary_zh: 过了不多日，耶稣周游各城各乡传道，宣讲神国的福音。和他同去的有十二个门徒，

title: Bethesda pool healing
summary: After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
summary_zh: 这事以后，到了犹太人的一个节期，耶稣就上耶路撒冷去。

title: 3rd Tour of Galilee
summary: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.
summary_zh: 耶稣走遍各城各乡，在会堂里教训人，宣讲天国的福音，又医治各样的病症。

title: 2nd Rejection at Nazareth
summary: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?
summary_zh: 来到自己的家乡，在会堂里教训人，甚至他们都希奇，说：「这人从哪里有这等智慧和异能呢？

title: Feeding of Five Thousand
summary: When Jesus heard of it, he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard thereof, they followed him on foot out of the cities.
summary_zh: 耶稣听见了，就上船从那里独自退到野地里去。众人听见，就从各城里步行跟随他。

title: Jesus Walks on Water
summary: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship, and to go before him unto the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
summary_zh: 耶稣随即催门徒上船，先渡到那边去，等他叫众人散开。

title: Healing in Gennesaret
summary: And when they were gone over, they came into the land of Gennesaret.
summary_zh: 他们过了海，来到革尼撒勒地方。

title: Commandments and Tradition Discourse
summary: Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees, which were of Jerusalem, saying,
summary_zh: 那时，有法利赛人和文士从耶路撒冷来见耶稣，说：

title: Healing Canaanite Daughter
summary: Then Jesus went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.
summary_zh: 耶稣离开那里，退到泰尔、西顿的境内去。

title: Feeding of Four Thousand
summary: Then Jesus called his disciples unto him, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.
summary_zh: 耶稣叫门徒来，说：「我怜悯这众人；因为他们同我在这里已经三天，也没有吃的了。我不愿意叫他们饿著回去，恐怕在路上困乏。」

title: Peter's Confession "Upon this Rock"
summary: When Jesus came into the coasts of Cesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?
summary_zh: 耶稣到了凯撒利亚•腓立比的境内，就问门徒说：「人说我─（有古卷没有我字）─人子是谁？」

title: Foretelling the Death and Resurrection
summary: From that time forth began Jesus to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.
summary_zh: 从此，耶稣才指示门徒，他必须上耶路撒冷去，受长老、祭司长、文士许多的苦，并且被杀，第三日复活。

title: The Transfiguation
summary: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart,
summary_zh: 过了六天，耶稣带著彼得、雅各，和雅各的兄弟约翰，暗暗地上了高山，

title: Healing a Boy with a Demon
summary: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,
summary_zh: 耶稣和门徒到了众人那里，有一个人来见耶稣，跪下，

title: Second Foretelling of Death and Resurrection
title_zh: 第二次预言受死与复活
summary: And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:
summary_zh: 他们还住在加利利的时候，耶稣对门徒说：「人子将要被交在人手里。

title: Tax Coin in a Fish's Mouth
summary: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?
summary_zh: 到了迦百农，有收丁税的人来见彼得，说：「你们的先生不纳丁税（丁税约有半块钱）吗？」

title: Teachings on Humility/Temptation/Reconciliation
summary: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?
summary_zh: 当时，门徒进前来，问耶稣说：「天国里谁是最大的？」

title: Healing a Crowd near Sea of Galilee
title_zh: 在加利利海边医治众人
summary: And Jesus departed from thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and went up into a mountain, and sat down there.
summary_zh: 耶稣离开那地方，来到靠近加利利的海边，就上山坐下。

title: Discourse with Pharisees and Saducees
title_zh: 与法利赛人和撒都该人辩论
summary: The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came, and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven.
summary_zh: 法利赛人和撒都该人来试探耶稣，请他从天上显个神迹给他们看。

title: Healing a Blind Man at Bethsaida
summary: And he cometh to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man unto him, and besought him to touch him.
summary_zh: 他们来到伯赛大，有人带一个瞎子来，求耶稣摸他。

title: Samaritans Reject Jesus
title_zh: 撒玛利亚人不接待耶稣
summary: And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,
summary_zh: 耶稣被接上升的日子将到，他就定意向耶路撒冷去，

title: Good Samaritan Parable Taught
summary: And, behold, a certain lawyer stood up, and tempted him, saying, Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
summary_zh: 有一个律法师起来试探耶稣，说：「夫子！我该做甚么才可以承受永生？」

title: Jesus meets Martha and Mary
title_zh: 耶稣在马大和马利亚家
summary: Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
summary_zh: 他们走路的时候，耶稣进了一个村庄。有一个女人，名叫马大，接他到自己家里。

title: Bread of Life Sermon
summary: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that hi…
summary_zh: 第二日，站在海那边的众人知道那里没有别的船，只有一只小船，又知道耶稣没有同他的门徒上船，乃是门徒自己去的。

title: Feast of Tabernacles
summary: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Jews sought to kill him.
summary_zh: 这事以后，耶稣在加利利游行，不愿在犹太游行，因为犹太人想要杀他。

title: Woman Caught in Adultery
summary: And every man went unto his own house.

title: Light of the World/I am discourse
title_zh: 世界的光与“我是”的讲论
summary: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
summary_zh: 耶稣又对众人说：「我是世界的光。跟从我的，就不在黑暗里走，必要得著生命的光。」

title: Blind Man Healed
summary: And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.
summary_zh: 耶稣过去的时候，看见一个人生来是瞎眼的。

title: The Good Shepherd Teaching
summary: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.
summary_zh: 「我实实在在地告诉你们，人进羊圈，不从门进去，倒从别处爬进去，那人就是贼，就是强盗。

title: Feast of Dedication
summary: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.
summary_zh: 在耶路撒冷有修殿节，是冬天的时候。

title: Healing Blind Bartimaeus
summary: And as they departed from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.
summary_zh: 他们出耶利哥的时候，有极多的人跟随他。

title: Holy Week
summary: And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and were come to Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then sent Jesus two disciples,
summary_zh: 耶稣和门徒将近耶路撒冷，到了伯法其，在橄榄山那里。

title: Triumphal Entry
summary: And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and were come to Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then sent Jesus two disciples,
summary_zh: 耶稣和门徒将近耶路撒冷，到了伯法其，在橄榄山那里。

title: Temple Cleansed
summary: And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,
summary_zh: 耶稣进了神的殿，赶出殿里一切做买卖的人，推倒兑换银钱之人的桌子，和卖鸽子之人的凳子，

title: Debates in the Temple
summary: And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?
summary_zh: 耶稣进了殿，正教训人的时候，祭司长和民间的长老来问他说：「你仗著甚么权柄做这些事？给你这权柄的是谁呢？」

title: Olivet Discourse
summary: And Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to him for to shew him the buildings of the temple.
summary_zh: 耶稣出了圣殿，正走的时候，门徒进前来，把殿宇指给他看。

title: Sanhedrin Conspiracy
summary: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these sayings, he said unto his disciples,
summary_zh: 耶稣说完了这一切的话，就对门徒说：

title: Judas Plans Betrayal
summary: Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,
summary_zh: 当下，十二门徒里有一个称为加略人犹大的，去见祭司长，说：

title: The Last Supper
summary: Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover?
summary_zh: 除酵节的第一天，门徒来问耶稣说：「你吃逾越节的筵席，要我们在哪里给你预备？」

title: Prayer and Betrayal in Gethsemane
title_zh: 在客西马尼祷告与被卖
summary: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.
summary_zh: 耶稣同门徒来到一个地方，名叫客西马尼，就对他们说：「你们坐在这里，等我到那边去祷告。」

title: Jewish Trials
summary: And they that had laid hold on Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.
summary_zh: 拿耶稣的人把他带到大祭司该亚法那里去；文士和长老已经在那里聚会。

title: Judas' Suicide
summary: Then Judas, which had betrayed him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented himself, and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
summary_zh: 这时候，卖耶稣的犹大看见耶稣已经定了罪，就后悔，把那三十块钱拿回来给祭司长和长老，说：

title: Roman Trials
summary: And Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And Jesus said unto him, Thou sayest.
summary_zh: 耶稣站在巡抚面前；巡抚问他说：「你是犹太人的王吗？」耶稣说：「你说的是。」

title: Bearing Cross to Golgotha
summary: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross.
summary_zh: 他们出来的时候，遇见一个古利奈人，名叫西门，就勉强他同去，好背著耶稣的十字架。

title: Resurrection and Ascension
summary: In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.
summary_zh: 安息日将尽，七日的头一日，天快亮的时候，抹大拉的马利亚和那个马利亚来看坟墓。

title: Fig Tree Cursed
summary: Now in the morning as he returned into the city, he hungered.
summary_zh: 早晨回城的时候，他饿了，

title: Teaching by the Fig Tree
summary: And when the disciples saw it, they marvelled, saying, How soon is the fig tree withered away!
summary_zh: 门徒看见了，便希奇说：「无花果树怎么立刻枯干了呢？」

title: Lepers Healed
summary: And it came to pass, as he went to Jerusalem, that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.
summary_zh: 耶稣往耶路撒冷去，经过撒马利亚和加利利。

title: Discourse on the Kingdom and Other Parables
summary: And when he was demanded of the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God should come, he answered them and said, The kingdom of God cometh not with observation:
summary_zh: 法利赛人问：「神的国几时来到？」耶稣回答说：「神的国来到不是眼所能见的。

title: Zaccheus Converted and Parable of the Pounds
title_zh: 撒该归主与交银的比喻
summary: And Jesus entered and passed through Jericho.
summary_zh: 耶稣进了耶利哥，正经过的时候，

title: Teaching and Healing in Perea to Jerusalem
title_zh: 在比利亚教训医病，上耶路撒冷
summary: And he went through the cities and villages, teaching, and journeying toward Jerusalem.
summary_zh: 耶稣往耶路撒冷去，在所经过的各城各乡教训人。

title: Lazarus Raised form the Dead
summary: Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.
summary_zh: 有一个患病的人，名叫拉撒路，住在伯大尼，就是马利亚和她姊姊马大的村庄。

title: Chief Priests Conspire Against Jesus
summary: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.
summary_zh: 祭司长和法利赛人聚集公会，说：「这人行好些神迹，我们怎么办呢？

title: Jesus Withdraws to Ephraim
summary: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim, and there continued with his disciples.
summary_zh: 所以，耶稣不再显然行在犹太人中间，就离开那里往靠近旷野的地方去，到了一座城，名叫以法莲，就在那里和门徒同住。

title: Mary Anoints Jesus
summary: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.
summary_zh: 逾越节前六日，耶稣来到伯大尼，就是他叫拉撒路从死里复活之处。

title: Upper Room Discourse
summary: Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.
summary_zh: 他既出去，耶稣就说：「如今人子得了荣耀，神在人子身上也得了荣耀。

title: Crucifixion and Burial
summary: And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, They parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture did they cast lots.
summary_zh: 他们既将他钉在十字架上，就拈阄分他的衣服，

title: The Holy Spirit is promised
summary: And, being assembled together with them, commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which, saith he, ye have heard of me.
summary_zh: 耶稣和他们聚集的时候，嘱咐他们说：「不要离开耶路撒冷，要等候父所应许的，就是你们听见我说过的。

title: Jesus ascends to Heaven
summary: When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?
summary_zh: 他们聚集的时候，问耶稣说：「主啊，你复兴以色列国就在这时候吗？」

title: Matthias replaces Judas
summary: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day’s journey.
summary_zh: 有一座山，名叫橄榄山，离耶路撒冷不远，约有安息日可走的路程。当下，门徒从那里回耶路撒冷去，

title: The Holy Spirit comes
summary: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.
summary_zh: 五旬节到了，门徒都聚集在一处。

title: Peter preaches at Pentecost
summary: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, Ye men of Judea, and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words:
summary_zh: 彼得和十一个使徒站起，高声说：「犹太人和一切住在耶路撒冷的人哪，这件事你们当知道，也当侧耳听我的话。

title: The church grows
summary: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles’ doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.
summary_zh: 都恒心遵守使徒的教训，彼此交接，擘饼，祈祷。

title: Lame man healed
summary: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour.
summary_zh: 申初祷告的时候，彼得、约翰上圣殿去。

title: Peter preaches in Solomon's Portico
title_zh: 彼得在所罗门廊下讲道
summary: And as the lame man which was healed held Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.
summary_zh: 那人正在称为所罗门的廊下，拉著彼得、约翰；众百姓一齐跑到他们那里，很觉希奇。

title: Peter and John's Trial
summary: And as they spake unto the people, the priests, and the captain of the temple, and the Sadducees, came upon them,
summary_zh: 使徒对百姓说话的时候，祭司们和守殿官，并撒都该人忽然来了。

title: Believers pray for boldness
summary: And being let go, they went to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said unto them.
summary_zh: 二人既被释放，就到会友那里去，把祭司长和长老所说的话都告诉他们。

title: Believers share all things
summary: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul: neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common.
summary_zh: 那许多信的人都是一心一意的，没有一人说他的东西有一样是自己的，都是大家公用。

title: Ananias and Sapphira lie to God
title_zh: 亚拿尼亚和撒非喇欺哄神
summary: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,
summary_zh: 有一个人，名叫亚拿尼亚，同他的妻子撒非喇卖了田产，

title: Apostles work signs and wonders in Solomon's Portico
title_zh: 使徒在所罗门廊下行神迹奇事
summary: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.
summary_zh: 主藉使徒的手在民间行了许多神迹奇事；他们（或译：信的人）都同心合意地在所罗门的廊下。

title: Apostles arrested, put on trial
summary: And laid their hands on the apostles, and put them in the common prison.
summary_zh: 就下手拿住使徒，收在外监。

title: Gamaliel advises the counsel and Apostles freed
title_zh: 迦玛列劝议会，使徒获释
summary: Then stood there up one in the council, a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in reputation among all the people, and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space;
summary_zh: 但有一个法利赛人，名叫迦玛列，是众百姓所敬重的教法师，在公会中站起来，吩咐人把使徒暂且带到外面去，

title: Seven chosen to serve
summary: And in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplied, there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.
summary_zh: 那时，门徒增多，有说希腊话的犹太人向希伯来人发怨言，因为在天天的供给上忽略了他们的寡妇。

title: Stephen is seized
summary: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people.
summary_zh: 司提反满得恩惠、能力，在民间行了大奇事和神迹。

title: Stephen addresses the council
summary: Then said the high priest, Are these things so?
summary_zh: 大祭司就说：「这些事果然有吗？」

title: Stephen is stoned
summary: When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.
summary_zh: 众人听见这话就极其恼怒，向司提反咬牙切齿。

title: Saul persecutes the church
summary: And Saul was consenting unto his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except the apostles.
summary_zh: 从这日起，耶路撒冷的教会大遭逼迫，除了使徒以外，门徒都分散在犹太和撒马利亚各处。

title: Philip preaches in Samaria
summary: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word.
summary_zh: 那些分散的人往各处去传道。

title: Conversion of Ethiopian Eunuch
summary: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza, which is desert.
summary_zh: 有主的一个使者对腓利说：「起来！向南走，往那从耶路撒冷下迦萨的路上去。」那路是旷野。

title: Saul is converted
summary: And Saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went unto the high priest,
summary_zh: 扫罗仍然向主的门徒口吐威吓凶煞的话，去见大祭司，

title: Saul proclaims Jesus
summary: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.
summary_zh: 就在各会堂里宣传耶稣，说他是神的儿子。

title: Peter heals Aeneas and Dorcas
title_zh: 彼得医治以尼雅，使多加复活
summary: And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all quarters, he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda.
summary_zh: 彼得周流四方的时候，也到了居住吕大的圣徒那里；

title: Peter meets Cornelius
summary: There was a certain man in Cesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band,
summary_zh: 在凯撒利亚有一个人，名叫哥尼流，是「意大利营」的百夫长。

title: Peter preaches to gentiles in Caesarea
title_zh: 彼得在该撒利亚向外邦人传道
summary: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:
summary_zh: 彼得就开口说：「我真看出神是不偏待人。

title: Peter defends Gentile salvation
title_zh: 彼得为外邦人得救辩明
summary: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
summary_zh: 使徒和在犹太的众弟兄听说外邦人也领受了神的道。

title: Disciples first called Christians
title_zh: 门徒称为基督徒从安提阿起首
summary: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only.
summary_zh: 那些因司提反的事遭患难四散的门徒直走到腓尼基和塞浦路斯，并安提阿；他们不向别人讲道，只向犹太人讲。

title: Herod kills James
summary: Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church.
summary_zh: 那时，希律王下手苦害教会中几个人，

title: Herod imprisons Peter
summary: And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to take Peter also. (Then were the days of unleavened bread.)
summary_zh: 他见犹太人喜欢这事，又去捉拿彼得。那时正是除酵的日子。

title: An angel rescues Peter from prison
summary: And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison.
summary_zh: 希律将要提他出来的前一夜，彼得被两条铁链锁著，睡在两个兵丁当中；看守的人也在门外看守。

title: Herod dies
summary: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: but they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king’s chamberlain their friend, desired peace; because their country was nourished by the king’s country.
summary_zh: 希律恼怒泰尔、西顿的人。他们那一带地方是从王的地土得粮，因此就托了王的内侍臣伯拉斯都的情，一心来求和。

title: First missionary journey begins
summary: But the word of God grew and multiplied.
summary_zh: 神的道日见兴旺，越发广传。

title: First Missionary Journey
summary: But the word of God grew and multiplied.
summary_zh: 神的道日见兴旺，越发广传。

title: Barnabas and Saul go to Cyprus
title_zh: 巴拿巴和扫罗往塞浦路斯
summary: So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.
summary_zh: 他们既被圣灵差遣，就下到西流基，从那里坐船往塞浦路斯去。

title: Mission to Antioch in Pisidia
title_zh: 在彼西底的安提阿传道
summary: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.
summary_zh: 保罗和他的同人从帕弗开船，来到旁非利亚的别加，约翰就离开他们，回耶路撒冷去。

title: Mission to Iconium
summary: And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spake, that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed.
summary_zh: 二人在以哥念同进犹太人的会堂，在那里讲的，叫犹太人和希腊人信的很多。

title: Mission to Lystra and Derbe
summary: They were ware of it, and fled unto Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and unto the region that lieth round about:
summary_zh: 使徒知道了，就逃往吕高尼的路司得、特庇两个城和周围地方去，

title: Return to Antioch in Syria
summary: And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,
summary_zh: 对那城里的人传了福音，使好些人作门徒，就回路司得、以哥念、安提阿去，

title: Jerusalem Council
summary: And certain men which came down from Judea taught the brethren, and said, Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.
summary_zh: 有几个人从犹太下来，教训弟兄们说：「你们若不按摩西的规条受割礼，不能得救。」

title: Paul and Barnabas part ways
summary: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
summary_zh: 但保罗和巴拿巴仍住在安提阿，和许多别人一同教训人，传主的道。

title: Second Missionary Journey begins
summary: And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God.
summary_zh: 保罗拣选了西拉，也出去，蒙弟兄们把他交于主的恩中。

title: Timothy Joins Paul and Silas
title_zh: 提摩太加入保罗和西拉
summary: Then came he to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek:
summary_zh: 保罗来到特庇，又到路司得。在那里有一个门徒，名叫提摩太，是信主之犹太妇人的儿子，他父亲却是希腊人。

title: Mission to Phrygia, Galatia and Asia
title_zh: 在弗吕家、加拉太和亚细亚传道
summary: Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia, and were forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia,
summary_zh: 圣灵既然禁止他们在亚细亚讲道，他们就经过弗吕家、加拉太一带地方。

title: Call to Macedonia
summary: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.
summary_zh: 在夜间有异象现与保罗。有一个马其顿人站著求他说：「请你过到马其顿来帮助我们。」

title: Lydia's Conversion
summary: And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side, where prayer was wont to be made; and we sat down, and spake unto the women which resorted thither.
summary_zh: 当安息日，我们出城门，到了河边，知道那里有一个祷告的地方，我们就坐下对那聚会的妇女讲道。

title: Paul casts demon out of soothsayer
title_zh: 保罗赶出使女身上的巫鬼
summary: And it came to pass, as we went to prayer, a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination met us, which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying:
summary_zh: 后来，我们往那祷告的地方去。有一个使女迎著面来，她被巫鬼所附，用法术，叫她主人们大得财利。

title: Paul and Silas imprisoned
summary: And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone, they caught Paul and Silas, and drew them into the marketplace unto the rulers,
summary_zh: 使女的主人们见得利的指望没有了，便揪住保罗和西拉，拉他们到市上去见首领；

title: Philippian jailer converted
summary: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.
summary_zh: 约在半夜，保罗和西拉祷告，唱诗赞美神，众囚犯也侧耳而听。

title: Paul and Silas released
summary: And when it was day, the magistrates sent the serjeants, saying, Let those men go.
summary_zh: 到了天亮，官长打发差役来，说：「释放那两个人吧。」

title: Uproar in Thessalonica
summary: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews:
summary_zh: 保罗和西拉经过暗妃坡里、亚波罗尼亚，来到帖撒罗尼迦，在那里有犹太人的会堂。

title: Mission to Berea
summary: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea: who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews.
summary_zh: 弟兄们随即在夜间打发保罗和西拉往庇哩亚去。二人到了，就进入犹太人的会堂。

title: Paul preaches in Athens
summary: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was stirred in him, when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry.
summary_zh: 保罗在雅典等候他们的时候，看见满城都是偶像，就心里著急；

title: Mission to Corinth, 1&2 Thess Written
title_zh: 在哥林多传道，写帖撒罗尼迦前后书
summary: After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth;
summary_zh: 这事以后，保罗离了雅典，来到哥林多。

title: Return from Second Missionary Journey
summary: And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while, and then took his leave of the brethren, and sailed thence into Syria, and with him Priscilla and Aquila; having shorn his head in Cenchrea: for he had a vow.
summary_zh: 保罗又住了多日，就辞别了弟兄，坐船往叙利亚去；百基拉、亚居拉和他同去。他因为许过愿，就在坚革哩剪了头发。

title: Third Missionary Journey Begins
summary: And a certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent man, and mighty in the scriptures, came to Ephesus.
summary_zh: 有一个犹太人，名叫亚波罗，来到以弗所。他生在亚历山大，是有学问（或译：口才）的，最能讲解圣经。

title: Mission to Ephesus/1 Cor Written
title_zh: 在以弗所传道，写哥林多前书
summary: And it came to pass, that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus: and finding certain disciples,
summary_zh: 亚波罗在哥林多的时候，保罗经过了上边一带地方，就来到以弗所；在那里遇见几个门徒，

title: Riot in Ephesus
summary: And the same time there arose no small stir about that way.
summary_zh: 那时，因为这道起的扰乱不小。

title: Mission to Macedonia and Greece
summary: And after the uproar was ceased, Paul called unto him the disciples, and embraced them, and departed for to go into Macedonia.
summary_zh: 乱定之后，保罗请门徒来，劝勉他们，就辞别起行，往马其顿去。

title: Eutychus revived
summary: And upon the first day of the week, when the disciples came together to break bread, Paul preached unto them, ready to depart on the morrow; and continued his speech until midnight.
summary_zh: 七日的第一日，我们聚会擘饼的时候，保罗因为要次日起行，就与他们讲论，直讲到半夜。

title: Voyage to Miletus
summary: And we went before to ship, and sailed unto Assos, there intending to take in Paul: for so had he appointed, minding himself to go afoot.
summary_zh: 我们先上船，开往亚朔去，意思要在那里接保罗；因为他是这样安排的，他自己打算要步行。

title: Paul speaks to Ephesian Elders
title_zh: 保罗对以弗所长老讲话
summary: And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus, and called the elders of the church.
summary_zh: 保罗从米利都打发人往以弗所去，请教会的长老来。

title: Voyage from Miletus to Jerusalem
title_zh: 从米利都航往耶路撒冷
summary: And it came to pass, that after we were gotten from them, and had launched, we came with a straight course unto Coos, and the day following unto Rhodes, and from thence unto Patara:
summary_zh: 我们离别了众人，就开船一直行到哥士。第二天到了罗底，从那里到帕大喇，

title: Paul visits elders in Jerusalem
title_zh: 保罗在耶路撒冷见众长老
summary: And the day following Paul went in with us unto James; and all the elders were present.
summary_zh: 第二天，保罗同我们去见雅各；长老们也都在那里。

title: Paul arrested in the Temple
summary: And when the seven days were almost ended, the Jews which were of Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the people, and laid hands on him,
summary_zh: 那七日将完，从亚细亚来的犹太人看见保罗在殿里，就耸动了众人，下手拿他，

title: Paul gives his testimony
summary: And as Paul was to be led into the castle, he said unto the chief captain, May I speak unto thee? Who said, Canst thou speak Greek?
summary_zh: 将要带他进营楼，保罗对千夫长说：「我对你说句话可以不可以？」他说：「你懂得希腊话吗？

title: Paul goes before the Council
summary: On the morrow, because he would have known the certainty wherefore he was accused of the Jews, he loosed him from his bands, and commanded the chief priests and all their council to appear, and brought Paul down, and set him before them.
summary_zh: 第二天，千夫长为要知道犹太人控告保罗的实情，便解开他，吩咐祭司长和全公会的人都聚集，将保罗带下来，叫他站在他们面前。

title: The conspiracy to kill Paul
summary: And when it was day, certain of the Jews banded together, and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink till they had killed Paul.
summary_zh: 到了天亮，犹太人同谋起誓，说：「若不先杀保罗就不吃不喝。」

title: Paul sent to Felix
title_zh: 保罗被解到腓力斯那里
summary: And he called unto him two centurions, saying, Make ready two hundred soldiers to go to Cesarea, and horsemen threescore and ten, and spearmen two hundred, at the third hour of the night;
summary_zh: 千夫长便叫了两个百夫长来，说：「预备步兵二百，马兵七十，长枪手二百，今夜亥初往凯撒利亚去；

title: Paul appeals to Caesar
summary: Now when Festus was come into the province, after three days he ascended from Cesarea to Jerusalem.
summary_zh: 非斯都到了任，过了三天，就从凯撒利亚上耶路撒冷去。

title: Agrippa and Bernice meet Festus
title_zh: 亚基帕与百尼基见非斯都
summary: And after certain days king Agrippa and Bernice came unto Cesarea to salute Festus.
summary_zh: 过了些日子，亚基帕王和百妮基氏来到凯撒利亚，问非斯都安。

title: Paul goes before Agrippa
title_zh: 保罗在亚基帕面前申诉
summary: Then Agrippa said unto Festus, I would also hear the man myself. To morrow, said he, thou shalt hear him.
summary_zh: 亚基帕对非斯都说：「我自己也愿听这人辩论。」非斯都说：「明天你可以听。」

title: Journey to Rome begins
summary: And when it was determined that we should sail into Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners unto one named Julius, a centurion of Augustus’ band.
summary_zh: 非斯都既然定规了，叫我们坐船往意大利去，便将保罗和别的囚犯交给御营里的一个百夫长，名叫犹流。

title: Paul's Journey to Rome
summary: And when it was determined that we should sail into Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners unto one named Julius, a centurion of Augustus’ band.
summary_zh: 非斯都既然定规了，叫我们坐船往意大利去，便将保罗和别的囚犯交给御营里的一个百夫长，名叫犹流。

title: Paul is shipwrecked by a storm
summary: And when the south wind blew softly, supposing that they had obtained their purpose, loosing thence, they sailed close by Crete.
summary_zh: 这时，微微起了南风，他们以为得意，就起了锚，贴近克里特行去。

title: Paul stays at Malta
summary: And when they were escaped, then they knew that the island was called Melita.
summary_zh: 我们既已得救，才知道那岛名叫马耳他。

title: Paul arrives at Rome
summary: And after three months we departed in a ship of Alexandria, which had wintered in the isle, whose sign was Castor and Pollux.
summary_zh: 过了三个月，我们上了亚历山大的船往前行；这船以「宙斯双子」为记，是在那海岛过了冬的。

title: Paul's First Roman imprisonment
title_zh: 保罗第一次在罗马被囚
summary: And it came to pass, that after three days Paul called the chief of the Jews together: and when they were come together, he said unto them, Men and brethren, though I have committed nothing against the people, or customs of our fathers, ye…
summary_zh: 过了三天，保罗请犹太人的首领来。他们来了，就对他们说：「弟兄们，我虽没有做甚么事干犯本国的百姓和我们祖宗的规条，却被锁绑，从耶路撒冷解在罗马人的手里。
